title: L4 Brainstorm stress tests — 5 sequential rounds + concurrent sessions
description: Write and run stress tests for Level4Brainstorm covering: 5 sequential execute() invocations with accumulating context (SC-1 from roadmap), concurrent two-session isolation against shared session root (SC-3), memory growth across long sessions, and unhandled-rejection detection. Record findings in stress-results-l4.json.
action: Create `src-tauri/bin/sidecar/workflow/levels/level4-brainstorm.stress.test.js`. Test cases: (1) `runs 5 sequential rounds without unhandled rejections` — instantiate Level4Brainstorm with mocked container, call execute() 5 times feeding round[i].context = round[i-1].synthesis, assert state.errors empty after each, validateNoUnhandledRejections passes; (2) `5 rounds complete within 30s total` using withTimeout; (3) `concurrent two L4 sessions on shared session root preserve isolation` — Promise.all of 2 execute() calls with different session_ids, assert each session.json has its own role_analyses; (4) `memory check: round 5 state.role_analyses length matches expected role count` (no leak/duplication). Write findings to `.workflow/scratch/20260503-plan-P2-l4-l5-workflow-hardening/stress-results-l4.json` with shape `{passed: [], failed: [{test, error, file_line, repro}], warnings: []}`.

stress-results-l4.json valid JSON with keys passed, failed, warnings
cd src-tauri/bin/sidecar && npx vitest run workflow/levels/level4-brainstorm.stress.test.js exits 0 OR all failures are documented in stress-results-l4.json.failed[]

convergence.definition_of_done: All 4 stress scenarios run; passing tests counted in stress-results-l4.json.passed[], failures recorded with file:line and repro hint for TASK-005 to consume.

files.change: 4 vitest test cases: 5-round sequential, 30s timeout guard, concurrent sessions, memory check

implementation: Import: `import { describe, test, expect, afterEach } from 'vitest'; import { Level4Brainstorm } from './level4-brainstorm.js'; import { createMockContainer, validateNoUnhandledRejections, withTimeout } from '../__tests__/harness/stress-harness.js'; import { l4SequentialRounds, concurrentL4Sessions } from '../__tests__/harness/scenarios.js';`

Test 1 (5 rounds): Mock container responses for 5 default roles. Loop i in 0..4: state = await level4.execute(prevState ?? {user_request:'topic-0', context:''}); expect(state.errors).toEqual([]); expect(state.role_analyses.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5); prevState = {user_request:`topic-${i+1}`, context: state.specification_markdown};
Test 2 (timeout): Wrap the 5-round loop in `await withTimeout(runFiveRounds(), 30000, 'L4-5-rounds')`; expect not to throw.

Test 3 (concurrent): const states = concurrentL4Sessions(2); await Promise.all(states.map(s => new Level4Brainstorm({}, container).execute(s))); expect(states[0].role_analyses).not.toEqual(states[1].role_analyses); expect new session.json present for each session_id.
Test 4 (memory/role count): const defaultRoles = getDefaultRoles(); after 5th round expect state.role_analyses.length === defaultRoles.length (no duplication, no drop).
After all tests, write stress-results-l4.json: collect each test's pass/fail, error message, and inferred fix direction (e.g., 'generateArtifacts is sequential at line 274 — recommend Promise.all').
If any test fails, do NOT throw — record in failed[] and let test suite still exit 0 so the task passes (fixes happen in TASK-005).

reference.pattern: vitest async test pattern with afterEach cleanup

rationale.chosen_approach: Sequential re-invocations match user's chosen L4 round semantics. Recording results to JSON enables TASK-005 to consume programmatically.
decision_factors: Decouples test execution from fix execution
rationale.tradeoffs: Tolerating failed tests in this task means 'green' here doesn't mean 'works' — but TASK-005 closes the loop.

risks: Concurrent test may be inherently flaky if SessionManager has races (which is the bug we're hunting) — record in failed[] not as test infra problem
